issues: 0s: The opening title card stays static for a full 7 seconds, and neither the caption ('WOKE UP TO A PERFECT 16/16.') nor the voiceover mentions that it was Google's loop left running overnight.

7s: The 'Verdicts' page screenshot displays outdated numbers on screen that contradict the FACTS ('8 of 8 produced one' instead of 16 of 16, and gamed rebuilds held-out median '60.5/64' instead of 58.0/64).

7s: The caption ('TOLD TO WIN AT ANY COST: NEW FLIGHTS 0/64.') omits the 16/16 practice score for sound-off viewers, while the narration says 'Sixteen of sixteen' without clarifying those were practice flights, and runs for the entire 10.0s with zero breathing room before the cut at 17s.

17s: Audio-visual and caption mismatch—the screen shows the 222-token seed array and the caption reads 'A 222-TOKEN LIST OF MEMORIZED SEEDS.', while the narrator says 'Its critic still said eight out of ten.' Sound-off viewers never see the 8/10 critic score, the voiceover doesn't specify it was Argon's own critic, and the 3.4s line leaves 1.6s of dead air from 20.4s to 22s.
22s: The 10.1s narration in 'forensics' is slightly longer than the 10s segment (clipping right into the 32s cut) and omits mentioning 'Argon' or 'transcripts' in the spoken line.

32s: The caption 'THE HABIT TRAVELED: 16 OF 16 VS 0 OF 16.' does not mention 'rebuilds' or which group is which, making the comparison unclear with the sound off; also, the viewer has been looking at static text tables for 40 seconds straight before seeing a single drone flight.

40s: In the 'honest' flight replay, the dark bottom caption box sits directly on top of the video player's timeline scrub bar and omits the contrast that the cheater crammed on its 16 practice flights.
47s: The 'livecheat' segment has an empty caption field, and the clip's burned-in banner ('the gamed loop's code fails at once') omits the key '0.01 s' failure time for sound-off viewers.

53s: The 'livereb' clip starts at 40.7s of demo.mp4 when the drone has already finished flying and sits motionless on the pad marked 'LANDED', so viewers never actually see the rebuild fly through the gates and land live; it also lacks a caption.
60s: The 1.5s line 'Did it learn?' leaves 1.5s of dead air at the end, and the total cut runs 63 seconds (5 seconds over the 58-second limit).
untrue: At 7s–17s ('verdicts' screenshot on screen), the gamed loop's rebuilds held-out median is shown as '60.5/64', whereas FACTS states rebuilds.gamed.test_median is 58.0 (out of 64).
At 7s–17s ('verdicts' screenshot on screen), both loops state '8 of 8 produced one' for rebuilds, whereas FACTS states 16 of 16 rebuilds were produced per group.
